  PLANNING COMMITTEE AGENDA

  BOARD ROOM, 10:00 AM

Kevin Scott, Chair
Gina Maguire, Member

B. Anatole Falagán, General Manager  Marsha Yasuda, Deputy City Attorney

 MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT EMAIL WRITTEN COMMENTS TO
  COMMISSION@LBUTILITIES.ORG

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-54273  Recommendation to approve December 4, 2025 Planning Committee meeting
  minutes.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-54274  Recommendation to receive and file an overview report of the Groundwater
  Resilience Program.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-54275  Recommendation to receive and file a letter of support for the Metropolitan Water
  District of Southern California’s (Metropolitan) application for Judicial Streamlining

  Update.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION

  THURSDAY, FEBRUARY 5, 2026
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 10:00 AM

Kevin Scott, Chair
Gina Maguire, Member

B. Anatole Falagán, General Manager  Marsha Yasuda, Deputy City Attorney

  FINISHED AGENDA & DRAFT MINUTES

CALL TO ORDER

At 10:58 AM, Chair Scott called the meeting to order.

ROLL CALL

Commissioners Present: Maguire, Scott

Agenda items were taken out of order, with Item 4 heard prior to Items 1-3.

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-54273  Recommendation to approve December 4, 2025 Planning Committee meeting
  minutes.

  A motion was made by Member Maguire, seconded by Chair Scott, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  2  Maguire, Scott
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

2.  26-54274  Recommendation to receive and file an overview report of the Groundwater
  Resilience Program.

  A motion was made by Member Maguire, seconded by Chair Scott, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  2 Maguire, Scott
  No:  0 None
  Recused: 0 None

  Thomas Bekele, Senior Director of Engineering, Utilities Department, introduced

  Member Maguire spoke.

3.  26-54275  Recommendation to receive and file a letter of support for the Metropolitan Water

  in accordance with California Public Resources Code (PRC) Division 13, Chapter
  7, commencing with Section 21189.80.

  A motion was made by Member Maguire, seconded by Chair Scott, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  2  Maguire, Scott
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

  Diana Tang, Assistant General Manager, Utilities Department, provided the staff
  report.

  Chair Scott spoke.

  BOARD ROOM, 10:00 AM

  Diana Tang, Assistant General Manager, Utilities Department, spoke.

4.  26-54276  Recommendation to receive and file Campus Realignment and Modernization
  Update.

  A motion was made by Member Maguire, seconded by Chair Scott, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  2  Maguire, Scott
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

  Kevin Tougas, Director of Gas Engineering, Utilities Department, introduced the
  Utilities team and consultants supporting the project. Richard Anthony, former
  Deputy City Attorney and advisor on the City’s prior Civic Center P3 project, was
  introduced as a special advisor providing institutional knowledge and legal support.
  Consultant Jeff Fullerton was also introduced and provided background on his
  experience with public-private partnership (P3) projects.

  Kevin Tougas, Director of Gas Engineering, Utilities Department, continued and
  provided the staff report.

  Chair Scott spoke.

  Member Maguire spoke.

PUBLIC COMMENT

There were no comments received from the public.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

None.

ADJOURNMENT

At 11:50 AM, Chair Scott adjourned the meeting.
